items.question: What alternative vessel may be properly filled with cow-dung for the prescribed rite?
premises: A clay pot is presented as an alternative vessel.
The pot must be properly filled with cow-dung.
items.inference: A clay pot properly filled with cow-dung serves as an acceptable alternative vessel in the ritual procedure.
uncertainties: The exact ritual use of this filled pot depends on the preceding and following instructions.
items.plain_english: Or take a clay pot and properly fill it with cow-dung.
